name: Handstand push-up
description: A full vertical press upside down against a wall. Pike push-ups move more weight onto the hands until the wall version is possible.

steps.label: Pike push-up
steps.cue: Hips high, lower your head ahead of your hands.

steps.label: Elevated pike push-up
steps.cue: Get your hips over your hands as much as you can.

steps.label: Deficit elevated pike push-up
steps.cue: Lower your head below hand level with control.

steps.label: Wall handstand push-up negative
steps.cue: Take three to five seconds to lower every rep.

steps.label: Wall handstand push-up
steps.cue: Hands a short way from the wall, elbows angled slightly forward.

steps.label: Deficit wall handstand push-up
steps.cue: Lower your head below your hands and press to lockout.
